name: Weather
author: Omarchy
description: Weather pill with detail popup and wallpaper animations

schema.label: Animate the wallpaper
schema.description: Draw the current conditions over the wallpaper: rain, snow, fog, cloud shadow, and a soft flash in a thunderstorm. Costs roughly 5-9% of a core per screen showing the desktop, so it is off by default. Stops while the session is locked, on a screensaver, in power saving on battery, and under a fullscreen window.
